definitions.R: K^R = sym(P), P = (I + D^-1 A_L)/2, zero-degree rows one-hot
definitions.D: s_i = sum_j K^R_ij ; K^D_ij = s_i s_j / sum_k s_k
definitions.triplet_convention: unordered e<=f of the symmetric matrix; diagonal weight halved in pair_aggregate

checks_note: R/D/U enumerate exactly the same unordered pair list (n(n+1)/2 per molecule), so pair-MLP FLOPs and batch composition are identical across arms; only the weights differ.  Zero-weight terms still instantiate the same phi computation.
